'''Jorge Alberto Sábato''' (June 4, 1924 – November 16, 1983) was an [[Argentina|Argentine]] [[physicist]] and technologist.

In 1955, he created the Metallurgy department at [[CNEA]], and was its director up to 1968 when he became Technology manager of the [[CNEA]]. While with the CNEA he promulgated the [[Sabato triangle|Sábato triangle]] model, dealing with interrelationships between science, government and industry in promoting scientific and technological development.

In 1976, he was one of the creators of INVAP SE, he was the spiritual godfather, introducing the concept of "Technology Company".

In 1993, the [[Instituto Sábato]] was created as a result of all his effort towards the development of materials science in Argentina.
